messages:
Maria K.: Heads-up — forecasting shows we're going to need ~220 dedicated A100s in ap-southeast-2 and 180 in eu-west-1 for Q3 committed pools. Need to start quota/limit requests and a short playbook for burst reservations. Can folks help draft the cloud support cases and callouts for ENI/EIP/NAT limits?

Raj P.: Thanks — rough numbers ok. Do we have weekly p95 token load or just peak concurrency?

Maria K.: We have both. P95 concurrent streams -> 650 in APAC peak hours, EU -> 520. Peak token throughput translates to the A100 counts above assuming current batching. Filing for quota increases needs instance + EIP + ENI headroom.

Lucy H.: Added a quick spreadsheet with conservative and aggressive projections: https://tiny.redwood/spread/q3-dedicated-gpu (link)

Kevin (oncall): Also watch network limits in ap-southeast-2 — region has strict per-account ENI limits on the instance types. Recommend asking for: 
- ENI limit bump to 5000
- EIP limit to 2000 (we use NAT EIPs for warm pools)
- VPC elastic IP soft limit pre-warm

Maria K.: Good call. Can we standardize the support text? Copy below — please edit: 
```
We are Redwood Inference (prod workloads). Requesting quota increases to support dedicated GPU pools: 
- ec2:RunInstances (A100 family) -> +220 in ap-southeast-2, +180 in eu-west-1
- EC2 Elastic IPs -> +1500 in ap-southeast-2, +1200 in eu-west-1
- EC2 Network Interfaces (ENI) -> +5000 per region
- VPC route tables and NAT gateway throughput validation / guidance for warm pool pre-warm
Rationale: enterprise committed customers + expected burst traffic during marketing events (projected peak on 2025-08-15). We need quota bumped asap for capacity reservations and to enable capacity-optimized placement.
```

Raj P.: Minor tweak: include desired SLA for turnaround (48h) and mention capacity reservations will be created once quotas are approved. Also call out we may request regional placement groups.

Lucy H.: I'll add the cost impact section for finance: rough monthly incremental EIP charges and reservation premiums. Quick note in sheet.

infra-bot: Created support case AWS Case 9876543210 — subject: "Quota increase for dedicated GPU pools (ap-southeast-2, eu-west-1)". Case link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/?caseId=9876543210

Kevin (oncall): We should also open a ticket with our cloud provider partner for priority handling. I'll ping the partner channel. :rocket:

Maria K.: Thanks. Action items: 
- @Lucy H. finalize spreadsheet & cost delta by EOD
- @Raj P. finalize support case text and desired turnaround request
- @Kevin (oncall) open partner escalation + check ENI/EIP quotas for sibling accounts
- I'll queue capacity reservations once quotas are approved and confirm CIDR/NAT requirements

Raj P.: For the internal playbook, suggest we add a fallback plan: allow burst to interruptible instances in a different AZ and auto-scale down after 15m if spot interruption occurs. Keeps service online while we wait for quota fill.

Lucy H.: Added fallback notes and an initial tally of one-time reservation costs in the spreadsheet.

Maria K.: Great — I'll paste the final support payload to the case and update this thread when AWS responds. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Case update received (1950112378) — "Quota increase approved pending verification". AWS note: "We need confirmation of your planned reservations and an expected go-live date."

Raj P.: Replying to AWS now with go-live date 2025-08-01 and attach the reservation plan. Will update here when done.

Maria K.: Marking this thread as the canonical playbook for Q3 dedicated pool quota requests. If anyone adds steps (runbook commands, contact POC) please append below.
